note: ALA-LC Azerbaijani Romanization Table, 2017 version, pp. 6-7 (Cyrillic script section); held source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-azerbaijani.pdf. Extraction: PDF text layer, every value cell cross-checked against the rendered page image. Tesh-ligature digraphs (TS͡/ts͡, IU͡/iu͡, IA͡/ia͡, U+0361) and candrabindu values (I̐/i̐, I + U+0310) transcribed as printed. The lower-case ҝ vernacular cell carries a parenthetical variant glyph that is illegible at 600 dpi and smudged in the print itself; it belongs to the vernacular column, not the romanization, and is documented here rather than transcribed. The map is the 1997 table; the only locally-held printed source is the 2017 version (the table page lists "Earlier versions: 2011, 1997"); the letter table matches the map's encoding and the version difference is recorded here. Skipped printed rows: ъ/ь — the printed value cells read "ʺ (hard sign)" / "ʹ (soft sign)"; the descriptors are stripped and the sign characters transcribed as printed.
